title: 📋 FRIDAY 21 AUGUST 2026 — PULL DAY WORKOUT SHEET
content:
📋 FRIDAY 21 AUGUST 2026 — PULL DAY WORKOUT SHEET

[HEADER]
Session: Pull Day (Lats, Upper Back, Rear Delts, Biceps + Matrix Bike)
Time Cap: 45 Mins Max | Salt Ayre Gym
Hydration: 1.5L water + 1 electrolyte tab pre-gym
Breathing: Continuous exhale on pull (RPE 7-8 max, NO Valsalva breath-holding)
Joint & Wrist Rule: Apple Watch moved 2-3 inches UP forearm. Dual-pulley cable station ONLY.

[EXERCISES]

1. CABLE LAT PULLDOWN (Dual-Pulley Cable Station) (Lats / Mid-Back)
   * Safety: Pull to upper chest, elbows drive down and back. Full stretch at top.
   - Feeder Set: 45kg x 10 (Joint prep)
   - Working Set 1: 52kg x 10
   - Working Set 2: 59kg x 10 [Last: 59kg x 10] ➜ OVERLOAD TARGET: 59kg x 11-12 reps OR 59kg + 1 adder pin (61.3kg) x 8-10 reps
   - Drop Set: 45kg x 8
   * Plan B Swap: Neutral-Grip Lat Pulldown Machine (50kg)

2. CABLE FACE PULLS (Rear Delts / ACJ Shoulder Stability)
   * Safety: Rope attachment. Pull to face/eye level, elbows flared high.
   - Feeder Set: 19.3kg x 12
   - Working Set 1: 26.1kg x 12
   - Working Set 2: 28.4kg x 10 [Last: 28.4kg x 10] ➜ OVERLOAD TARGET: 28.4kg x 11-12 reps OR 28.4kg + 1 adder pin (30.7kg) x 8-10 reps
   * Plan B Swap: Incline Rear Delt DB Flyes (6kg DBs)

3. UNSUPPORTED SEATED CABLE ROW (Dual-Pulley Cable Station) (Back Thickness)
   * Safety: Neutral V-bar or parallel handle. Torso upright, no excessive lower back swing.
   - Working Set 1: 39kg x 10
   - Working Set 2: 52kg x 8
   - Working Set 3: 59kg x 3 [Last: 59kg x 3] ➜ OVERLOAD TARGET: 59kg x 5-6 reps
   - Drop Set: 45kg x 6
   * Plan B Swap: Chest-Supported Machine Row (43kg)

4. CABLE BICEP CURLS (Straight Bar) (Biceps Finisher)
   * Safety: Strict elbow tuck, no shoulder elevation.
   - Working Set 1: 19.3kg x 10
   - Working Set 2: 23.8kg x 10
   - Working Set 3: 26.1kg x 8 [Last: 26.1kg x 8] ➜ OVERLOAD TARGET: 26.1kg x 9-10 reps OR 28.4kg x 6-8 reps
   * Plan B Swap: EZ Bar Cable Curls (21.6kg)

5. DB CONCENTRATION HAMMER CURLS (Forearms & Brachialis)
   * Safety: Neutral grip, slow eccentric.
   - Working Set 1: 12.5kg x 10 [Last: 12.5kg x 10] ➜ OVERLOAD TARGET: 12.5kg x 11-12 reps
   - Working Set 2: 12.5kg x 10 [Last: 12.5kg x 10] ➜ OVERLOAD TARGET: 12.5kg x 11-12 reps
   * Plan B Swap: Standing DB Hammer Curls (12.5kg)

6. MATRIX STATIONARY BIKE CARDIO (Bleep Test VO2 Max Conditioning)
   * Protocol: 4:30 – 5:00 Mins Total (30s Sprint Level 4 / 30s Active Recovery Level 3)
   * Rule: Active recovery pedal (NEVER freeze feet). Sip water immediately post-ride.
   * Plan B Swap: Assault Bike / AirBike
